title: Appointment Scheduling Attendance Thresholds: Count Window, Booking Restriction and Dismissal Review
content:
Riverbend Regional Health counts no-shows and late cancellations on **Appointment Scheduling** appointments over a rolling count window, and sets per visit type the no-show counts at which booking is restricted and at which the clinic reviews dismissal from the practice.

## Thresholds by visit type

| Visit type | Rolling count window (months) | No-shows at which booking is restricted | Restriction applied at that count | No-shows at which the clinic reviews dismissal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Primary Care Office Visit | 12 | 3 | same-day-only scheduling | 5 |
| Telehealth Video Visit | 12 | 3 | same-day-only scheduling | 5 |
| Specialty New-Patient Consultation | 12 | 3 | provider review before booking | 5 |
| Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) | 12 | 2 | provider review before booking | 4 |
| Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment | 12 | 3 | care team outreach | 6 |
| Pre-Admission Testing Appointment | 12 | 3 | surgeon's office review | 5 |
| Outpatient Procedure Appointment | 12 | 2 | surgeon's office review | 3 |

## Column meanings

- **Rolling count window** — the rolling months over which no-shows and late cancellations are counted; 12 months for every visit type.
- **No-shows at which booking is restricted** — the number of no-shows in the count window at which booking is restricted.
- **Restriction applied** — the restriction applied at that count.
- **Dismissal review** — the number of no-shows in the count window at which the clinic reviews dismissal from the practice.

## Count ladder — hypothetical no-show counts

The counts below are invented to show how the thresholds read for two visit types.

| No-shows in the count window | Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) | Outpatient Procedure Appointment |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | below both thresholds | below both thresholds |
| 2 | restriction count reached: provider review before booking | restriction count reached: surgeon's office review |
| 3 | restriction count reached | restriction count and dismissal-review count (3) reached |
| 4 | restriction count and dismissal-review count (4) reached | restriction count and dismissal-review count reached |
